capabilities: Open .log files in a dedicated read-only view
Filter lines by text, severity, and timestamp presence
Show raw source with line numbers and highlighting
Report line, timestamp, severity, and render-cap counts
extras: Read-only by design and never writes to log files; renders only the first 10,000 lines (with a cap warning) to keep Obsidian responsive; makes no network requests and does not use the clipboard. Marked v0.1 with beta releases available via BRAT.
motivation: Logs are evidence, and editing or normalizing them can damage timestamps, stack traces, multiline records, and raw diagnostic context.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse plaintext .log files with structure, severity labels, and filtering while keeping the source file untouched.
summary: Read-only viewer that opens .log files in Obsidian with a structured table, severity badges, timestamp detection, filters, and a raw source view.
